scenarios.text:
From the following, extract every decision that was made, who owns it, and any stated deadline. Present as a compact list. If a decision has no clear owner, say so explicitly.

'After two weeks of evaluation the team decided to postpone the tablet refresh to the following quarter because the display supplier could not guarantee panel volumes.
